items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I'll let you know, Mr. Russell. ... Well, I tell you though, Mr. Russell, I really think it's better.

ctx.x: You think you'd use it again, Allie?

No, I wouldn't use it again, but I'd just keep it. Yeah. The old keepsake, I'd like to have one. Yeah. But I'm going to see a guy, and if I do... I'll let you know, Mr. Russell. If you find an extra one, I wouldn't want to take one of you... One of yourself, but sometimes... If you find one where I could buy one, I'd sure be glad to get one too. You have everything in two cases. Your base drum and everything else goes in one case then, does it? I'm at a job, I'm supposed to play tonight, I don't know. I never…
How often do you work nowadays?
